name: Finger-count palm-wipe reveal
description: A close-lens 1–2–3–4 finger count followed by a palm-cover cut into a rear-facing reveal and single turn toward camera.
lockedGrammar: Palm fully hides the cut around 3.9s
One turn toward camera while holding hair or braid

variables.description: Same fictional or authorized person in both takes.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional adult with a consistent face
examples: a woman with copper box braids

variables.description: Wardrobe shared across the hidden cut.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Create {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation in {{setting}}, wearing {{wardrobe}}, close to a locked vertical phone with one finger raised near the lens.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Count clearly and evenly from one to two to three to four with distinct stable finger states, then move an open palm forward until the lens is fully covered at 3.9s. Keep {{subject_identity}} stable.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Begin fully palm-occluded in the same {{setting}}, then reveal the same {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation and {{wardrobe}} from behind.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Pull the palm away, reveal the subject already back-facing, then make one clean turn toward camera while holding their hair. Do not turn away and back. Preserve {{subject_identity}}.

deterministicLayers.template: Join the two takes only through full palm occlusion; no dissolve or generated morph.
Apply {{audio_policy}} over the exact format timeline.

promptExamples: Use the finger-count palm-wipe format with a blonde woman in green gymwear.

notes: The first attempt incorrectly used one generation and missed the hidden two-take reset.
Recipe stores the corrected two-take grammar but needs a new live validation before default reuse.
